items.title: MakeMyTrip Co-Founder on India IPO and the AI Question Investors Stopped Asking
items.summary: MakeMyTrip is trying to answer three questions at once: can it stay relevant as AI reshapes travel discovery, can a string of small acquisitions build real value rather than just organizational sprawl, and does a domestic listing finally make sense after 16 years on Nasdaq?

items.title: Cathay Pacific CEO: Summer Demand Is Holding Up Despite Fuel Price Shock
items.summary: Strong summer demand and weakened rivals are buying Cathay room to absorb the fuel spike – the test is whether that cover holds once the peak fades.

items.title: Aviation’s 2050 Net-Zero Target Could Slip: ‘The More Likely Outcome’
items.summary: Willie Walsh has acknowledged that the industry's flagship climate target may need to move, but a revised timeline will only mean something if it comes with binding commitments, not another round of aspirational pledges.

items.title: The Most Interesting Thing Hoshino Resorts Is Doing Isn’t Luxury
items.summary: Hoshino cracked the code budget hotels have ignored for decades — OMO makes money by sending guests out the door.

items.title: Lighthouse Launches AI Assistant for Hotel Commercial Teams
items.summary: Hotel teams already have too many dashboards. Ernest has to prove it can simplify commercial work, not become one more place to check.

items.title: Why A&O Hostels Is Buying Europe’s Empty Buildings
items.summary: Most hospitality groups are shedding real estate. a&o is picking it up at distressed prices — a contrarian move that works up until the deals, or the lenders, run dry.

items.title: Klook Co-Founder Bets AI Can Finally Fix Travel Experiences Discovery
items.summary: Klook has no grand OTA ambitions, at least for now. Its bigger bet is that AI can smooth out the messiness of experiences booking and help it deepen its lead in the category while pulling travelers into adjacent trip spend.

items.title: How Ken Chenault Became Travel’s Most Consequential Non-Operator
items.summary: One person connects the Amex GBT take-private, Airbnb’s board, a $10.75 billion travel loyalty startup, and Berkshire Hathaway’s governance committee.
